title: The Right Byte First: How UTF-16 Helps Multilingual Boundary Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.22071v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many hierarchical byte-level language models group bytes into patches using a learned boundary predictor whose view of the next codepoint depends on encoding and lookahead. In UTF-8, codepoints of many scripts take three bytes: 8 of 24 bits mark length and continuation, and the first byte carries only 4 high codepoint bits. After the same left context, a mark extending a grapheme cluster and a letter starting the next can thus share their first byte. Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE) keeps one- and two-byte UTF-8 encodings but writes these codepoints as two UTF-16 bytes, low byte first, so its first symbol carries 8 low codepoint bits that can distinguish such continuations. We train small causal predictors on matched FineWeb-2 text and evaluate on FLORES-200 under UTF-8, UBE, and UBE's same-length big-endian variant. translated_title: 正确的字节优先：UTF-16 如何助力多语言边界预测
translated_abstract: 许多分层字节级语言模型使用学习到的边界预测器将字节分组为补丁，而该预测器对下一个码点的观察视角取决于编码方式和前瞻符号数。在 UTF-8 中，许多文字的码点占用三个字节：24 位中有 8 位用于标记长度与延续性，而首字节仅携带 4 个高码点位。因此，在相同的左侧上下文之后，延长字素簇的组合标记与开启下一个字素的字母可能共享相同的首字节。通用字节级编码（UBE）保留一字节和两字节的 UTF-8 编码，但将此类码点写作两个 UTF-16 字节（低字节在前），使其首符号携带 8 个低码点位，足以区分这类延续情况。我们在匹配的 FineWeb-2 文本上训练小型因果预测器，并在 FLORES-200 上于 UTF-8、UBE 以及 UBE 的等长大端变体三种编码下进行评估。在单符号前瞻条件下，针对 13 种婆罗米文字中 17 种语言在码点边界处的平衡字素边界错误率……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出通用字节级编码（UBE），将三字节 UTF-8 码点改写为低字节在前的两个 UTF-16 字节，使边界预测器从首个符号即可获得更多区分信息，从而提升多语言字素边界预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), which rewrites three-byte UTF-8 codepoints as two UTF-16 bytes with the low byte first, giving the learned boundary predictor more distinguishing information in the first symbol and thereby improving multilingual grapheme boundary prediction.
